# yyds-lang
> A YYDS language monorepo with grammar, AST, lexer, parser, semantic analysis, language service, and editor tooling.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/yyds-lang/
GitHub: https://github.com/yyds-lang/yyds
Documentation: https://github.com/yyds-lang/yyds/tree/main/docs
Status: documented candidate
Last verified: 2026-11-17
